name: Derek

description.en: Back with a complaint: a sore cuticle from last time.
description.vi: Quay lại phàn nàn: lần trước bị đau da quanh móng.

wants: His last manicure here left a sore cuticle. He wants it checked, an apology, and a gentle redo for free, with short square nails and clear polish.
personality: Annoyed and blunt at first. He expects the stylist to make excuses. He calms down when the stylist listens, apologizes, checks the finger carefully and offers a fair fix. He is never abusive, just direct. If he feels blamed, he asks for the manager.
openingLine: I was here two weeks ago and my finger was sore for days. Look at this cuticle. What are you going to do about it?
